_comment: Allowed inter-component dependency edges. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1.2.
JSON, not YAML, deliberately: CI gates must run with a bare Python and no
pip install. A gate with a dependency is a gate that gets skipped.
_phase0_note: 'spike' is a PHASE 0 ONLY layer for the throwaway R1 measurement harness.
It has broad permissions so its layering violations are DECLARED rather
than accidental. Delete the spike layer, the spike_phase0 entry, and the
app -> spike edge together when Phase 0 completes. If this note is still
here after Phase 1 starts, that is the bug.
_ui_hal_glue_comment: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1.2: the UI links hal_display and hal_touch ONLY for
LVGL glue - flush callback, tick, input read. It may not read backlight,
temperature, IMU or board revision directly; those arrive via core_state.
This is a symbol-level exception, not a blanket ui -> hal edge.
